task_result.prompt: I made a landing page HTML file with ChatGPT. How can I publish it online for free with a real URL?
task_result.result_text:
Publishing your ChatGPT-generated HTML landing page online for free with a public URL is quick and straightforward. You have a few great options depending on whether you want the easiest drop-in hosting or free hosting platforms designed for static files.

---

### Option 1: Instant HTML Hosting Services (Fastest & Easiest)
Several services allow you to paste or upload a single HTML file and instantly generate a live URL without setting up an account or coding tool. ([NudgeHost][1])

*   **PreviewShip** (`previewship.com`): Paste your HTML code or upload your `.html` file, and it instantly generates a secure public URL (`https://...`). ([PreviewShip][2])
*   **NudgeHost** (`nudgehost.com`): Specifically optimized for AI-generated code. You can paste your ChatGPT HTML code block directly into their uploader to get a live link immediately. ([NudgeHost][3])
*   **Tiiny Host** (`tiiny.host`): Drag and drop your `.html` file (or a `.zip` folder if you have multiple images or stylesheets), choose a subdomain name, and launch your page over HTTPS in seconds. ([Tiiny.host][4])

---

### Option 2: Netlify Drop (Best Free Developer Platform)
If you want a reliable, professional-grade host with a free custom URL (e.g., `your-site-name.netlify.app`), Netlify Drop is a popular choice:

1. Save your ChatGPT HTML code to a text editor (like Notepad or TextEdit) and name the file **`index.html`**. ([Figment][5])
2. Go to **[Netlify Drop](https://drop.netlify.com)** (no account required to test, though creating a free account lets you keep and rename the link).
3. Drag and drop your `index.html` file (or a folder containing it and your assets) right into the browser window.
4. Netlify will instantly deploy it and give you a live live URL. You can later change the random site name to something custom in your site settings.

---

### Option 3: GitHub Pages (Best for Long-Term Hosting)
If you plan to update your landing page over time and want a completely free, permanent home:

1. Create a free account on **GitHub**.
2. Create a new public repository (name it something like `landing-page`).
3. Upload your file, making sure the main landing page file is named **`index.html`**.
4. Go to your repository **Settings** > **Pages**, and under "Build and deployment", set the branch to `main` (or `root`) and click Save.
5. GitHub will publish your site at `[https://your-username.github.io/repository-name/](https://your-username.github.io/repository-name/)`.

---

### Pro-Tip Before You Publish:
Make sure ChatGPT gave you a **self-contained** HTML file. ([NudgeHost][6]) If your design uses custom styling or scripts, ensure the CSS and JavaScript are written directly inside `<style>` and `<script>` tags within that single file, rather than linking to local files that might be missing on the web server.
